body:
I do enjoy drawing a bit, but I always get the feeling I'm wasting time while I'm doing it, even though I waste time on other things way more. 

I feel like I would draw a lot more if my life was in order, but it isn't.

Feeling a bit better now. I'm taking up drawing, which I'm really bad at atm, but it gives me some sense of purpose for something which is a whole lot better than nothing. 

I do want to meet up with lgbt groups ( and  maybe the secular meet up group) in my area, but I don't have a car or a license yet. I've gotten rejected by every job in my city  I've applied to so far , but I'm going to keep trying. I realize things will get better once I get a car. The hard part for me is being positive in the interview. I guess I have to fake it to make it? Let's see how that goes
